answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 21344 Country: India Title: I have asked this question before, but you did not answer, Kindly answer this time. I am engaged to a girl who is my cousin and my marriage is going to happen very soon, I wanted to know the interpretation of my dream- " In the dream, I am saying to my parents that i don't want to marry her, later on her parents also come to know about my intension, but after some time i again regret my decision and tell my parents that i made a mistake, i want to marry the same girl(ie., my cousin)".. please give the meaning of this dream, i was very worried after seeing this kind of dream, because i liked this girl and told my parents of my intention, everything is of my choice and will only, but seeing this kind of dream is making me worried. Question: Assalamualaikum, I have asked this question before, but you did not answer, Kindly answer this time. I am engaged to a girl who is my cousin and my marriage is going to happen very soon, I wanted to know the interpretation of my dream- " In the dream, I am saying to my parents that i don't want to marry her, later on her parents also come to know about my intension, but after some time i again regret my decision and tell my parents that i made a mistake, i want to marry the same girl(ie., my cousin)".. please give the meaning of this dream, i was very worried after seeing this kind of dream, because i liked this girl and told my parents of my intention, everything is of my choice and will only, but seeing this kind of dream is making me worried. Jazakallah... Answer ID: 21344 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 795/604/H=1431) Your heart seems to tend towards adornment and elegance, the dream warns for the same that the result of the world and its glitter and elegance is nothing but dirt and filth. It is a great loss to love it and forget the death and the hereafter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
